ops.text: Guest keys go into the public repo without their comments; usernames from the email name minus digits
ops.why: The repo is public, so colleagues' keys are committed without their trailing email comments (a key needs none); the public keys themselves are fine to publish. The first three guests (yaxpatel, sameerjuin, siddhpatel) take their usernames from their email's local part without digits, chosen by the agent, easy to rename before their first login. Each also gets a Slurm association through modules.slurm.
